name: Ekdalia Evergreen Club
description:
Ekdalia Evergreen Club is one of South Kolkata’s most prestigious and crowd-favorite Durga Pujas, known for its grandeur, elegance, and commitment to tradition. Every year, the club impresses visitors with its majestic pandal design, classic themes, and divine idol presentation.

The organizers beautifully maintain the balance between artistic creativity and religious sanctity. The lighting and decorations around the area add a festive charm that attracts countless devotees and visitors. Despite the huge crowds, the arrangements for crowd management, safety, and traffic control are well-coordinated, ensuring a smooth experience for all.

The puja’s long-standing reputation for quality and devotion makes it a landmark in Kolkata’s Durga Puja map. Ekdalia Evergreen Club continues to set a benchmark for excellence, blending heritage with modern execution.

A must-visit pandal for anyone wishing to witness the true grandeur of Kolkata’s Durga Puja. 🌸✨

name: Singhi Park Sarbojanin Durga Puja Committee
description:
Visited on 3rd October 2025.
Simple and beautiful, though an average pandal. It could be way more better.
The creativity, ideation, execution and presentation needs to be enhanced.
No comments on the idol. As Maa Durga is always perfect and beautiful.
Joy Maa Durga 🪷

name: Hindusthan Park Sarbojanin Durgotsab Committee
description:
One of the most underrated Durga Puja of South Calcutta...
Even if the pandal was not about a topic of discussion, their idol surely was and continues to be ...
Even this year they managed to pull out their creativity in every way possible.
Although I visited on the day before inaugural, I somehow managed to have a peek-a-boo on their artistry❤️

name: Tridhara Sammilani
description:
The 'Cholo Phiri' theme was a nostalgic masterpiece, beautifully capturing the essence of our roots and tradition."

"I was mesmerized by the 'Dhwani' installation; the blend of traditional brass work with sensor-driven light and sound was truly innovative."

"The Black-themed pandal and the live Shiv Tandav performance created a divine and powerful atmosphere that I’ll never forget."

"Tridhara remains one of the best spots in South Kolkata for its unique artistic vision
#Durgapuja2025 #kolkatadairies #maa

name: Deshapriya Park
description:
Deshapriya Park is always a crowd-puller during Durga Puja, and for good reason! The scale of the pandal, the majestic idol, and the creative themes every year make it truly unforgettable. The lighting and setup turn the whole park into a festive wonderland.
Even with the massive footfall, the arrangements are well-managed, and the atmosphere is electric. If you’re pandal-hopping in South Kolkata, Deshapriya Park is an absolute must-visit! 🎇🙌

name: Maddox Square Park
description:
Walking into Maddox Square, the first thing that hits me is the electric atmosphere. Between the sweeping spotlights of the 'City of Joy' stage and the cool winter breeze, the park felt completely transformed into a festive wonderland.📷
It was vibrant and full of life ,families, friends, and music lovers all coming together under the open sky.👀

Seeing the mini-rides and the giant wheel lit up brought back so much nostalgia. It’s that perfect mix of a modern music festival and a traditional Kolkata 'mela'.🥳🎉

One of the highlights was the curated collection of small businesses. I spent a good amount of time browsing through the boutique stalls. It was the perfect place to pick up unique, handcrafted items that you just can't find in big malls.🫀

name: Jagritee Durga Puja, Bhowanipore
description: Loved it !! Loved the ambience....loved tje puja.....loved the style of doing puja !! And specially loved the rthym of the dhakis playing dhak !! Decoration of the idols are also very good !! Overall , loved it !!

name: Chakraberia Sarbojanin Durgotsab
description: First time visited this puja and the experience was really worth it. The outstanding decoration and thinking. But crowd management is really really bad. There was a silicon art Durga Idol which looks exactly as real person.

name: Matri Mandir
description: A traditional place of worship of deities and religious festivals in the Hinduism pantheon, it is open to people of all faiths or those who lack one; some thoughtful programmes of interfaith genre are also held here.

name: 64 Pally Durga Pujo
description: I had a wonderful experience at 64 Pally this year! The theme was thoughtfully executed, and the ambiance felt festive and welcoming. The idol was stunning, and the pandal design had a unique charm. Despite the crowd, everything was well-managed. A memorable stop for anyone exploring the city’s top Durga Pujas.

name: Kalighat Milan Sangha
description: My experience at Kalighat Milon Sangha was average. The marriage hall is decent in size and works fine for a medium gathering, but it could be better maintained. The location is easy to reach, though the surrounding area gets crowded at times. The atmosphere inside is okay, not bad, but it could use better lighting and overall upkeep. It’s a workable option if you want something simple, but there’s definitely room for improvement.

name: Hazra Park Durga Puja
description:
I recently visited Hazra Park Durga Puja during Durga Puja, and it was a truly vibrant and enjoyable experience for me. From the moment I reached the pandal, I was impressed by the beautiful decorations, bright lighting, and creative theme work, which instantly created a festive and energetic atmosphere.

The idol of Goddess Durga was beautifully crafted, with intricate detailing and a graceful presence that reflected both devotion and artistry. I spent some time admiring the craftsmanship and soaking in the spiritual vibe of the place. The sound of dhak beats, devotional chants, and the lively crowd made the entire environment feel alive and full of celebration.

Even though there was a good crowd, the arrangements felt quite organized, allowing me to explore comfortably. Visiting Hazra Park Durga Puja gave me a strong sense of festive joy and cultural pride, making it another memorable stop during my Durga Puja pandal hopping across Kolkata.

name: Harish Park
description:
Enjoy a lot here !! There were many games and rides in the park. Food available. But the prices are higher than than rest food corner and stalls. I liked the variety of rides and the space to chill out and rest with family. Crowds were less than other pandals and liked the open space with sitting arrangement for people.
Playground
Large space to play sports

name: Rupchand Mukherjee Lane Durga Puja
description:
Mesmerized after witnessing the Devine idol of Maa Durga 🙏🏻🪷... The concept is just top of everything... Heart was not providing me permission to leave the pandal... I'm thankful to Maa Durga that this year I was able to visit this pandal and witness the Divine idol of her.
Joy Maa Durga 🙏🏻🪷 …

When I used to come here as child, it was just an unkept field but today the full premise has been given a premium look. The place is clean, well maintained. The club members were also present, perhaps one of the best things to have happened I would say.

description: Good pandal. Really decorative. Can give competition to big pujas if gets proper exposure as them. The place is also quite good as it's located in juncture of 3 streets. One can park their vehicles properly and go to watch the pandal. Even there is wooden sland placed so that one does not have to put their feet on mud. Overall very good pandal.

name: Bhowanipur 75 Palli
description:
Bhowanipore 75 Palli: A Stunning Tribute to "Binodini"!
Bhowanipore 75 Palli has created an absolutely awesome Durga Puja pandal this year. Their innovative and beautiful theme, "Binodini," is a spectacular tribute, showcasing remarkable and unique ideas. The pandal is stunning, and the idol is equally beautiful in its own way. This innovative display has created a fantastic atmosphere, and it’s a must-visit for all pandal-hoppers. Be sure to go ASAP to avoid the inevitable crowds!

description: One of the best shabekina pujo in Calcutta... Which has always put up to its tradition!!!... To watch the idol here is pure bliss!!! One automatically will become a devotee of maa durga by watching the DURGA MURTI!!! it is a must visit place during durga puja!!!

description: It is a club situated in Dhirendra Ghosh road.  They organize Durga puja every year. Their puja is usually theme based. This year (2021) they made pandal using hand fans. The decoration was too good. It is a must visit for pandal hoppers. It is near to Bhawanipore 76 palli Durga puja pandal.

name: Paddapukur Youth Association
description:
Visited on 02nd October 2025.
The frustration I got after visiting this pandal is at another level. Will never ever visit again.
Reason?
The reason behind this frustration is, this pandal committee members allows only the VIPs to get inside or infront of the pandal and visit whole the common people like us , has to visualise the pandal from a far distance,from where the idol of Maa Durga is not properly visible.
The committee members allows vlogers to shoot while the visitors like me are unable to see the idol because they are shooting or recording everything standing just infront of the idol.
Literally hated this pandal.
What's the purpose of decorating when you people don't allow visitors to visit!
You tried to showcase your artwork and tried to hype the pandal, but the actual fact is your all hardwork got wasted because no common people were able to witness it properly, clearly!
HATED THE PAAAAAAANDAAAAAAAAAL AND ALSO THE COMMITTEEEEEEEEE MEMBERS!

name: Chetla Agrani Durga Puja Pandal
description:
Chetla Agrani’s Durga Puja pandal is truly a visual treat. Every year they bring something unique, and this time the theme, lighting, and decoration were absolutely stunning. The detailing in the idol and the beautiful ambiance create a perfect festive vibe. Crowd management is also good, so you can enjoy comfortably.❣️

Overall, a must-visit pandal in Kolkata for its creativity, cultural feel, and smooth experience. Highly recommended for pandal-hoppers!🙏🏻♥️🙏🏻

name: Akaal Bodhan Durga Mandir
description:
I recently visited Akaal Bodhan Durga Mandir, and it was a truly serene and spiritual experience for me. The moment I entered, I felt a calm and devotional atmosphere that made it easy to focus on prayer and reflection. The idol of Goddess Durga was beautifully crafted, with intricate details that made the entire mandir feel traditional and sacred.

The surroundings were clean and peaceful, which added to the overall spiritual vibe. I appreciated how organized and welcoming the place felt, with volunteers and priests guiding devotees respectfully. Spending time here gave me a sense of connection to the festive spirit and the devotion of the community. Overall, visiting Akaal Bodhan Durga Mandir was uplifting and a truly enriching experience.

name: Akshra Temple New Alipore
description: One of the must watch Durga Puja of South Kolkata.. Unique structure with eye catching design and lighting is always their priorities.They also maintain COVID PROTOCOLS.Good crowd management and their parking space is also nearby to pandal..Do hop in if u are nearby.

name: Suruchi Sangha
description:
I had the privilege of visiting the Suruchi Sangha Puja Pandal this year, and I must say it was one of the most thought-provoking and moving experiences of Durga Puja. The theme revolved around the struggles and sacrifices of our freedom fighters during India’s fight for independence, and the organizers have truly brought history alive through their creativity.

The moment I stepped inside, I felt transported back to the pages of history. The pandal beautifully showcased various episodes of our independence movement — from the salt satyagraha to revolutionary struggles, from the voices of leaders like Netaji, Gandhi, and Bhagat Singh to the countless unsung heroes who gave their lives for the country. The artistry, detailing, and storytelling through installations were exceptional, creating a deep sense of respect and pride for our nation.

name: Alipore 78 Pally Club
description:
Located in South Kolkata, Alipore 78 Pally is known for its tasteful and artistic pandal design. The decoration focuses on simplicity and elegance, with beautiful lighting and a serene Durga idol. It avoids over-the-top themes and instead emphasizes tradition.

The puja is well-organized and less crowded, especially in the early evening, making it great for families and photographers. The atmosphere is peaceful, with devotional music and a community feel. Basic facilities like restrooms and refreshments are available.

A must-visit for those who appreciate refined celebration over hype.

name: Trikon Park
description:
A Gem of Green Space: My Review of Tricone Park
​Tricone Park is an absolute treasure for the community and one of the best green spaces I've ever visited. From the moment you step onto the grounds, you’re greeted by impeccably maintained lawns and vibrant floral displays that are clearly cared for with immense pride.
​What truly sets Tricone Park apart is its versatile appeal. Whether you're looking for a peaceful retreat or a place for active fun, it delivers. The walking trails are wide, clean, and shaded by mature trees, making them perfect for a morning jog or a relaxing evening stroll. Families will adore the modern playground equipment, which is safe, creative, and kept in pristine condition, offering hours of fun for kids of all ages.
​The park also features a great open field ideal for picnics, sports, or simply soaking up the sun. The atmosphere is consistently friendly and welcoming, a testament to both the respectful visitors and the hardworking staff. If you're looking for a beautiful, clean, and well-organized park to enjoy nature, exercise, or spend quality time with loved ones, Tricone Park is an absolute must-visit. It's a genuine five-star experience!

name: Chotushkone Park
description: My, mine and mine..  😊 Yes, it's my park. This small and cute Park marks it's 65+ years of Durga puja and in a gallant style.. from durgotsav to blood camps, this Park is the soul for our "para" …

name: 95 Pally Association
description:
I recently visited 95 Pally Association Durga Puja, and it was a really lovely experience for me. Right when I stepped inside, I was greeted by beautiful decorations and a warm, festive vibe that made everything feel joyful and inviting. The idol of Goddess Durga was crafted with great attention to detail, and the way it was displayed gave the whole pandal a very traditional and respectful feel.

The atmosphere around was full of celebration — with dhak beats, lights, and people from the community enjoying the festival together. I enjoyed walking around and seeing all the creative elements the organizers had put into the decorations. Even though there were quite a lot of people, the energy felt welcoming rather than chaotic.

There were also small food stalls and snacks nearby, which added to the fun of the visit. Overall, visiting 95 Pally Association Durga Puja made me feel really connected to the festive spirit, and it was one of the enjoyable and memorable Durga Puja visits I’ve had in Kolkata.

name: Babubagan Durgotsav
description:
I recently visited Babubagan Durgotsav Durga Puja, and it was a wonderful experience for me. The moment I entered the pandal, I was impressed by the beautiful decorations and vibrant lighting that created a lively and festive atmosphere. The idol of Goddess Durga was exquisitely crafted, with intricate details that made the whole setup feel both traditional and artistic.

The energy around was amazing — with dhak beats, lights, and people celebrating together, it felt joyful and welcoming. I enjoyed walking around, admiring the creative decorations, and soaking in the festive spirit of the community. There were also local food stalls where I tried some treats, which made the visit even more enjoyable.

Overall, visiting Babubagan Durgotsav Durga Puja gave me a strong sense of celebration and cultural connection, making it one of the most memorable Durga Puja experiences I’ve had in Kolkata.

name: Rajdanga Naba Uday Sangha
description:
A Beacon of Creativity and Community
Rajdanga Naba Uday Sangha is a true gem in Kolkata’s cultural landscape, particularly renowned for its exceptional Durga Puja celebrations. It’s more than just a local festival; it's an annual showcase of profound creativity and social consciousness.
What consistently sets this club apart is its ability to weave deep, often thought-provoking themes into its pandal and idol design, moving beyond mere spectacle to deliver a powerful message. From highlighting the plight of refugees with the theme 'Address' to exploring introspection with 'Proshno' ("The Question"), the organizers demonstrate an impressive commitment to conceptual artistry.
The sheer scale, intricate craftsmanship, and innovative use of materials in their decorations are a testament to the talent involved. Visitors are not only enthralled by the beautiful, unique idol of Maa Durga but also by the entire immersive experience. The club beautifully merges traditional devotion with modern, engaging conceptual art, making the visit a truly memorable one.
